fields.System.Title: FDN-602 — Manage multiple barcodes
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want a product to have several barcodes, so that the unit
code, the case code, and old labels still on stock all scan to the same product.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product, when I add a barcode, then scanning it resolves to that product.
  • - Given a barcode already used by another product, then adding it is rejected.
  • - Given a barcode, then it records which UoM it represents — a case code and a unit code
  • behave differently on receipt.
  • - Given a product with several barcodes, then one is marked primary for display.
  • - Given a barcode is removed, then a warning notes that stock labelled with it may still
  • exist.

Traceability

|---|---|

| Tables | product_barcode |
